step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture depicts an automated AWS account generation engine designed to provision sandbox accounts for engineers. 1. An engineer (User) submits an account provisioning request via a web portal to Amazon API Gateway. 2. API Gateway invokes a Validate Lambda function, which checks email and domain attributes. 3. Validate Lambda triggers SES to send an acknowledgment receipt to the user and enqueues the request into an SQS queue. 4. SQS triggers a Create Lambda function, which selects a master account using a least-used algorithm, invokes CloudFormation templates to provision the account/alerts, assigns organizational units (OUs) and SCP governance policies in AWS Organizations, and sends account credentials and notifications via SES.

graph.notes: Publicis Sapient's serverless platform for automated, governed AWS account creation and budget enforcement.

nodes.name: User
nodes.notes: Engineer submitting an account provisioning request through the portal.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Receives account provisioning requests from the user portal.

nodes.name: VALIDATE
nodes.notes: Validates request parameters such as email domain to confirm internal origin.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Decouples request validation from account creation.

nodes.name: CREATE
nodes.notes: Executes account creation, selects master account, configures OUs, and budget alerts.

nodes.name: ORGANIZATIONS
nodes.notes: Manages active and inactive OUs with Service Control Policies (SCPs) enforcing cost and security constraints.

nodes.name: CLOUDFORMATION
nodes.notes: Provisions account resources, blueprints, and budget alarms.

nodes.name: SES
nodes.notes: Sends request acknowledgment emails, account credentials, and budget usage notifications.

Validate Lambda sends validated request message to SQS queue.
